summary: The first text says new technologies arrive very fast; young people adapt quickly, while older people need more time to feel comfortable
According to the first text, a positive attitude and openness to innovation are crucial for progress and a bright future
The second text says people should not feel rushed and need time for practice and proper training, especially at work, which leads to more effective ways of doing tasks
The writer concludes that both texts show the importance of accepting new technologies, and that everyone should explore new innovations and let them become part of their lives
arguments: Young people adapt to new technology quickly, while older people need more time (first text)
A positive attitude and openness to innovation lead to progress and a bright future; exploring things is the key to success
Proper training at work gives people time to get familiar with innovations and leads to more effective ways of doing tasks (second text)
Accepting new technologies brings benefits for the entire population
arguments_main: Names accepting and opening up to new technologies as the most important argument (proper training is also acceptable)
Gives a reason from the text, e.g. both texts share this point and the conclusion repeats it
